title: An Incomprehensible Process
author: Sarita Jenamani
text:
< p>Wandering in orbit
merely results from
the force of attraction
Or may be an endeavour
to enter the navel of being

Asking for an answer
an exercise in futility

Bound by the frame of life
we remain hanging
on the wall of an exhibition
or keep on staring at the frame
like silent onlookers
– an incomprehensible process

What is simple,
is life
which is only the sum
of a few letters

First Rain in Vienna

Here the soil seldom exudes
the aroma
of earth refreshed
But in time
when the scents of the city rise
twiglets of memory shoot up
And somewhere deep down
loss strikes root.
stanzas: to enter the navel of being
Bound by the frame of life
on the wall of an exhibition
or keep on staring at the frame
when the scents of the city rise
